test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Lack of functional small intestine can cause a malabsorption disorder leading to diarrhoea, malnutrition, weight loss etc. This particular condition is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**short bowel syndrome**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Short bowel syndrome** is a condition caused by the lack of functional small intestine.
 
• It leads to **malabsorption disorders**, which can result in symptoms such as **diarrhoea, malnutrition, and weight loss**.
